05 / About the studio

A one-person studio, obsessed with the details.

I’m Abdul Moid — the solo designer and developer behind SolutionScale, building thoughtful digital experiences for clients I genuinely care about.

Founded in 2022, I’ve grown deliberately, choosing to stay independent so I can stay close to every project. I work directly with founders, design leads, and engineering teams — no middlemen, no hand-offs to junior contractors.

My practice sits at the intersection of taste and technology. I believe a website should be fast, accessible, and something you’re proud to share — not just a checkbox on a launch list.
